tell: A 1.8-hour elimination half-life, with activation by spontaneous hydrolysis rather than liver enzymes, sets this alkylating agent apart.

clues.text: A high-fat breakfast lowers Cmax by 32% and AUC by 9%. Only 15% of drug-related radioactivity is protein bound, and spontaneous hydrolysis at physiologic pH is the main conversion, with P450 enzymes playing a minor role.
A powder with a molecular weight of 194.15 for the parent compound.
Approved under an NDA as capsules from 5 to 250 mg, dosed once daily for 5 days in each 28-day cycle.
Contraindicated after serious hypersensitivity to it or to dacarbazine. Fatigue, convulsions and headache are the most common severe reactions.
Newly diagnosed glioblastoma with radiotherapy and maintenance, and adjuvant or refractory anaplastic astrocytoma.
Converts without enzymes at physiologic pH to a reactive compound that alkylates DNA, mainly at the O6 and N7 positions of guanine, causing double-strand breaks.
The generic name begins with T and has twelve letters.
